hints.title: Grid Jump Transitions
hints.text: From cell (i, j), you can transition to any (i, k) for j < k <= j + grid[i][j], or any (k, j) for i < k <= i + grid[i][j].

hints.title: Per-Row and Per-Column Envelopes
hints.text: Maintain min-heaps for each row and each column recording (dist, max_reach) of previously reached cells.

hints.title: Stale Reach Pruning
hints.text: When visiting (i, j), discard entries from row i's heap whose reach is less than j, and from column j's heap whose reach is less than i.

hints.title: Row-Column Heap DP Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is pushed and popped at most once per row and column heap.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through all jump steps takes O(m * n * (m + n)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) heap and distance storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains minimal distances per row/column using priority queues or segment trees.
